answer: Marble Attestation Lottery. Each new identity must submit a unique hardware-attested random seed; the registry hashes it against all prior seeds and admits only if no collision, then assigns the identity a periodic pulse challenge—a signed liveness beat at unpredictable intervals. Missing two beats voids the identity and forfeits its seed deposit. Cloning a seed produces a detectable collision at admission, forcing attackers to acquire fresh hardware per identity and sustain live pulses indefinitely. The jade ledger records each seed permanently,
